title: fix(components): size an auto-width column from what its cells draw, and stack right-pinned columns (objectui#11682)
body:
Fixes #11682
Clause-②: no

The data table sized an auto-width column from the length of its STORED value. It now sizes it from what the column's header and cells DREW, read back from the rendered table. Two right-pinned columns also no longer stick to the same edge. All of it lives in `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`: no producer change, no new column, view or schema key, and no second copy of a formatter.

## What was measured before building (the order's mechanism assumptions)

Live reading, one time: the showcase backend (objectstack `main` at `aa09db58`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`), the console dev server of this branch's base `9ca3cac` pointed at it, Chromium 1194, viewport 1440x900, the seeded admin. At 1440px the list's content box is 1184px wide (the sidebar takes 256px).

1. **Budget.** `budget` is `Field.currency` on `showcase_project`. A stored `150000` is drawn `150,000.00` (no tenant currency is set, so it is a plain grouped number). The estimate read `String(200000)`, which is 6 characters, so the column was 96px with a 72px content box. The widest amount needs 72.61px, so 3 of the 5 Budget cells truncated (scrollWidth 73 against clientWidth 72). The same 3 cells truncated on the CRM Workbench page. Confirmed.
2. **Where the drawn text comes from.** The table does not hold the formatter. A grid column's `cell` is a React renderer from `@object-ui/fields` (`CurrencyCellRenderer` calls `formatCurrency` with the tenant currency and display locale from its own hooks). `@object-ui/components` cannot import that package, and `col.type` alone carries no currency, scale or storage. The cheapest faithful source is the DOM those renderers drew, so that is what the estimate reads now. The table calls no formatter of its own for it.
3. **Progress under Actions.** `progress` on `showcase_task` is `type: 'progress'` (not `percent`), drawn by the percent cell renderer as a 64px bar beside the number. It is stored as whole points (`45`), not as `0.45` as the card says. Neither of the two causes the order named was the cause. The Progress estimate was not too small: its cell was not clipped (88 of 88px). Nor was a reserve missing for the pinned column. The other columns were too WIDE: Assignee got 240px for 171px of drawn text, Title 200px for 120px, Project 168px for 107px (a lookup arrives as an expanded object, and `String()` of it is 15 characters). The columns summed to 1230px in the 1184px box, so the scrolling region ran 46px under the right-pinned Actions column at scroll 0. That is where the right-aligned percentage sits: every Progress cell was 33px under Actions. The pinned column is not shrunk.
4. **An intermediate that did not hold.** Estimating from the drawn text's LENGTH (the old 8px a character) fixes Budget (128px), but the Tasks table grew to 1238px and Progress went 41px under Actions. That is why the width is now MEASURED where the page is laid out.

## What changed

- **Auto width from the drawn content.** Each auto-sized column's header label and display cells carry `data-auto-width-key`. A layout effect reads them back after every commit, before paint. Where the page is laid out, the column gets its widest target's natural width (at `max-content`) plus the space the cell keeps around its content. That space is measured (cell width less content box), not read from the computed padding. Under the table's collapsed borders, the column beside the frozen first column, and the one beside Actions, carry half of a neighbour's rule, which no computed style reports. With computed padding, the CRM Workbench's Status column came out 1px short and its "Completed" badge truncated. Where nothing is laid out (happy-dom, a table inside a hidden panel), the drawn text's length is the input to the old estimate. The stored value is read only before the first draw. The 80px floor and the 400px cap stay. A masked column is still sized from its header alone (objectui#10657). An explicit `width`, a `fitContent` column and a dragged width are unchanged.
- **When it re-reads.** The read is skipped when nothing drawn has changed: a signature of the targets' text and their cells' classes (density, a staged edit's weight). It runs again on a body mutation (a lookup cell resolves its name inside its own component, after the table rendered), on a table resize (a table shown from a hidden panel) and once the fonts have loaded. Only text and node changes are observed, and the state is replaced only when a size moved, so a read cannot feed itself. It is skipped while a cell is being edited.
- **Stacked right pins.** Every right-pinned column carried `right-0`. So a column an author pins right (`pinned: 'right'`, which `ObjectGrid` honours) beside the auto-pinned Actions column stuck to the same edge and was drawn under it. Measured in a harness at a 700px container: Due Date sat at [880..1000] under Actions at [933..1000]. Each right-pinned header and body cell now sticks at the measured width of the pinned cells after it, the mirror of `measuredStickyLefts`. After the change, Due Date sits at [538..633] beside Actions at [633..700]. A table with one right pin renders as before.

## Readings after the change (live, same setup, the tree at `3341132`)

| Page | Table / content box | Budget | Progress | Clipped cells | Cells under the last column at scroll 0 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Projects, All Projects | 1326 → 1184 / 1184 | 96px (truncated) → 107px, content 83px | | 3 → 0 | 10 → 0 |
| Tasks, All Tasks | 1230 → 1184 / 1184 | | 112px, 33px under Actions → 152px, whole | 0 → 0 | 10 → 0 |
| CRM Workbench | 760 → 651, its 3fr grid track | 96px (truncated) → 97px, content 73px | | 3 → 0 | 0 → 0 |

The scan checks every body cell and its descendants for scrollWidth above clientWidth, and every cell's drawn content for reaching past the left edge of the row's last cell.

## Pins: which are arithmetic and which replay geometry

`data-table-drawn-width-11682.test.tsx`. happy-dom lays nothing out.

- **Arithmetic (the text path):** a currency cell drawing `200,000.00` gets 128px (CONTROL: the same column drawing its stored value gets 96px). A lookup drawing `Mobile App` for a 16-character id gets 128px (it was 176px). A cell whose text arrives after the table rendered re-sizes the column (256px), through the body observer alone.
- **Replayed geometry:** a fake layout answers only the probe (an auto-width target at `max-content`), with the natural widths measured in Chromium on the two showcase lists. It replays the measured insets (24px, 25px beside the frozen rule, 24.5px beside Actions). A table that does not probe falls back to the text path, and the pins go red. Budget: the content box holds 72.61px. Tasks: the columns plus the measured fixed columns (checkbox, `#`, Actions) fit 1184px, and every column holds its widest drawn cell and label, Progress's 109.36px included. The probe leaves no inline width behind.
- **Mocked header widths:** two right pins, so the inner one sticks at the outer one's 67px and the outer one stays at `right-0`. CONTROL: one right pin renders as before.
- **Rewritten control** in `data-table-masked-client-paths-10657.test.tsx`: unflagged, the column is now sized from the mask its cells draw, not from the raw value. Flagged, its cells are not read at all, which still changes the width. The old control pinned exactly the stored-value branch this change removes.

The live readings above are the geometric half. They are one time and are not committed as a test: the repo's Playwright suite serves a production console build with no backend, so it cannot reach these lists.

## Ablation (one leg, from the committed fix)

`node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `setDrawnSizes(next);` with `void next;`, so the read-back never reaches the estimate and every column falls back to the stored value. The mutation was confirmed on disk (anchor 1 → 0, marker count 1 inside the run, blob `9b34e266` → `08662811`). Predicted: the 3 text pins, Budget, Tasks and the masked control red. Observed: exactly those 6 red, 12 green.

- `expected '96px' to be '128px'`, `expected '176px' to be '128px'`, `expected '104px' to be '256px'`
- `the content box holds the widest drawn amount: expected 72 to be greater than or equal to 72.61`
- `the columns sum to 1229.88px: expected 1229.88 to be less than or equal to 1184`
- `the drawn mask, not the raw value, sizes the column: expected '304px' to be '80px'`

Restored by the tool's own trap. Restore proof: blob after restore `9b34e266` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

⚠️ Declared narrowing: this leg ran OUTSIDE the shared verify lock, at `--maxWorkers=1`. Three locked attempts timed out in the queue (exit 99, NOT MEASURED). In each, the mutation landed and was restored. The lock was held for more than 30 minutes by another seat's full `packages/app-shell/` suite. The run was these two test files only.

## Verification (head `3341132`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/ packages/plugin-grid/ --maxWorkers=2` (locked): `Test Files 547 passed | 1 skipped (548)`, `Tests 5403 passed | 24 skipped (5427)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components build` (locked, dependency closure built first): exit 0.
- `@object-ui/components` `type-check` (both projects; `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0.
- `@object-ui/components` `lint`: 0 errors. The three touched files carry the same 35 warnings as the base copies of the two files that already existed. The package as a whole has 972 warnings, none of them errors.
- Exit 0: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check` (fixed group, no `major`), `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the four paths (NOT GOVERNED), and also `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:unreferenced-sources`.
- The repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the `check:*` farm are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **The width follows the rows that are drawn.** On a table that pages, searches or sorts its own rows (inline data), a column can change width with the page, the search or the sort. The console's object lists page and search on the server, so they were re-estimated per page before this change too.
- **A table wider than its container still scrolls under its pinned column.** At scroll 0, the right-pinned column overlays the scrolling columns that pass beneath it. That is what pinning is, and it is not changed here. At the scroll end nothing is covered (measured at a 700px container, Progress ends at 539px and the pinned cells begin at 538px, on their 1px rule). This change makes the measured lists fit, and makes pinned columns stop covering each other. The literal reading of "never covers" for an overflowing table is in the report.
- **The checkbox and `#` columns now take more of the spare width** (Tasks: 28 → 45px and 39 → 45px), because the auto columns are tighter. That is the browser's share-out of `w-full`, not a width this table sets.
- **Observation, not filed:** Projects' Budget Remaining (a formula over two currency fields) draws an ungrouped monospace `90000`.
- **Cost:** one layout effect per commit builds the signature. The two forced layouts happen only when it changes, or on a body mutation, a table resize or the fonts loading.
